notRun.notifications: OS notifications are not observable under WSLg/CDP; unit tests cover suppression, dedupe and click-to-focus.
notRun.unreadWhileUnfocused: CDP drives a focused window here; unfocused unread and notification suppression are covered by unit tests.
notRun.realClaudeSuccessfulStop: The isolated CLI is unauthenticated, so the real turn ends with StopFailure; a completed turn is covered by the shipped Hook probe and unit tests.
notRun.exitPlanMode: ExitPlanMode needs an authenticated model and an interactive plan approval; only domain mapping is unit-tested.
notRun.relaunchReset: Activity is in-memory by construction; no packaged relaunch was performed in this smoke.
